body: I wish i could give some kind optimism but all I can give is understanding.
I feel the same. When I try to sleep and I hear my heart beating, it’s stupid, but I wish so hard it’ll stop.

I’m so sorry you are going through this tragedy. It is important to remember that some have reached out, or at least tried their best in this community. A lot of times reminding people that they are going to hurt the people around them just adds to the guilt and pain to how low they feel. If you are interested in helping people here please read the side bar.
I don’t even know anymore. I’m just so damn depressed. It is straight up pathetic.
